steps.name: prove-parse-blocks-event-loop
ac: cd apps/api && set -a; . ./.env.local; set +a; uv run pytest tests/strategy/test_parse_event_loop_blocking.py -q
cd apps/api && set -a; . ./.env.local; set +a; test "$(uv run pytest tests/strategy/test_parse_event_loop_blocking.py --collect-only -q 2>/dev/null | grep -c '::')" -ge 3
cd apps/api && uv run ruff check tests/strategy
steps.summary: parse_preview 엔드포인트를 선택: 파스 시작 뒤 10회 asyncio.sleep(0) 양보 틱(0.2초 동기 스텁의 절반 관측 창에도 즉시 반환 대조가 안정적으로 완료하는 소량)을 측정하고, 스텁 sleep은 0.2초; step 1 대상은 test_parse_preview_blocks_event_loop_when_parse_to_ast_blocks, test_parse_preview_heartbeat_reaches_target_when_parse_to_ast_returns_immediately, test_parse_preview_calls_service_parse_to_ast.

steps.name: offload-parse-to-threadpool
ac: cd apps/api && set -a; . ./.env.local; set +a; uv run pytest tests/strategy/test_parse_event_loop_blocking.py -q
cd apps/api && set -a; . ./.env.local; set +a; uv run pytest tests/strategy -q
cd apps/api && uv run mypy src/strategy/service.py
cd apps/api && uv run ruff check src/strategy tests/strategy
